subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should forced gateway restart change from an immediate/no-wait escape hatch to a 5s best-effort drain for pending replies?
rationale: The patch fixes message loss but changes documented operator behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept bounded force drain
options.body: Merge after live pending-reply proof and help/docs alignment make the new 5s best-effort drain contract explicit.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different pending-reply recovery design that preserves the immediate forced restart contract.

options.title: Make it opt-in
options.body: Add a separate explicit mode for bounded forced drains while keeping existing `--force` behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded force drain
recommendation.body: Merge after live pending-reply proof and help/docs alignment make the new 5s best-effort drain contract explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is an operator-contract choice in a gateway lifecycle area with substantial adjacent history under this owner.
